subject.title: openclaw doctor should detect stale gateway lock files

question: Should the remaining gateway-lock doctor fix be handled by adopting/rebasing the open fork PR, or should that stale branch be closed and replaced with a narrow OpenClaw PR?
rationale: The source issue is valid and narrow, but GitHub still shows an open cross-repo PR with closing syntax that is conflicting and not maintainer-editable, so automation should not create another fix path without maintainer ownership direction.

options.title: Replace the stale fork branch
options.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR to implement the gateway-lock doctor check with current doctor-health patterns.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork work
options.body: A maintainer can manually port the useful branch contents onto current main and keep contributor credit, then close the stale fork PR after replacement exists.

options.title: Wait for the fork author
options.body: Leave the issue paired with the open fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase and add current proof before any new fix lane starts.

recommendation.title: Replace the stale fork branch
recommendation.body: Close or retire the conflicting fork PR and allow a fresh narrow OpenClaw PR to implement the gateway-lock doctor check with current doctor-health patterns.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on doctor health contribution structure and session-lock findings, which is the likely implementation boundary.
